title: Complete tools/instruments owner: native-tool correction, layered repair and exceptions
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete tools/instruments/making/repair palette with explicit source correction and exceptional-means refinements
reviews.disposition:
All 739 input lines were read, including TQ/CT/WX/AX/MC/RC/SB, IP1–IP9/VB1–VB12, all twenty WE rows, MT, making/damage/repair/input tables, layered repair, all exception rows through TQ296 and the final composed repair boundary. The document corrects its own original instrument-gap finding: TQ70–TQ78 show native tools/slots/required types, forging, opted-in durability, salvage and one loan already existed in the inspected source. TQ62 and the original Village-first proposal are superseded by the scoped IP plan, with IP1–IP3 reported implemented at its dated task receipt. The later table's still-in-progress phrasing is chronology, not a fresh declaration those delivered phases are absent. Current AD44/AD51 and PROJECT govern selection; no new Village/JJK prerequisite wave is dispatched.

Retain product, power container and instrument as complementary roles of one actual item. One item identity/custody owner, actual source/effect owner and read-only instrument profile avoid duplicated condition or capability flags. Fit, precision, hardness, balance, charge, station support and user body can affect different consumers; a grade is not automatically a damage multiplier. The early no-tool/no-verb, every-common-verb-has-improvisation and every-world-becomes-data claims are not universal implementations. Functional substitutions and body/cheat means can supply a role, while an actual unmodeled mechanism remains a gap. Defining fields/rows does not make a new delivery, repair or world law executable. A station is not just a free label, and a loan/service retains real participant, custody, availability and time owners.

The CT/WX/WE/TQ170–TQ189 franchise rows retain their stated MEMORY/W/C/O/P/U source classes and qualifiers. Later corrections refine optional attunement, compatible Ashes, Asauchi versus imprint, exceptional projection and FMA continuity. The public-canon summaries are not fresh paragraph qualification; wand allegiance-by-defeat, every LOTM item side effect, only-soul-keyed loop retention, blade/original-maker restrictions and grimoire/copy absolutes cannot be imported as complete universal source law. An item kind's name need not exclude it from another real role: a sealing object can also be an instrument when a supported action uses it. A borrowed tool can route power without transferring the old wielder's mastery. Body repair, refuel, re-enchant, rebind, identity, social title and institutional paperwork are different outcomes.

Rounds4–5 explicitly replace original-maker-only and hard-input permission lists with actual layer reach, partial outcomes, couplings, matching materials/methods, collaborators, exceptional makers and knowledge claims. Better repairers may exceed the original maker, lesser makers can succeed through fitting means and world-stated absolutes describe ordinary cases with supported exceptions. The source text preserves old wording, including WE2's residual original-smith-only first-job phrase; read it under the later correction. One repaired layer is not full restoration. Diagnosis and visible success can be mistaken; actual unknown damage can still act. A repairer may affect a hidden layer indirectly through a real coupling, so TQ212's cannot-target shorthand must not imply unknown truth is inert. Similar skill/notes do not force every world into a level-comparison formula, and a soul/fit repair need not always take elapsed time if an actual mechanism restores it instantly.

Exception source, provenance, reason and actual scope are useful. Mandatory rising cost, rarity, institutional attention, once-an-era creation or a new all-exception ledger are additional proposals, not required balancing taxes. The final AD22/AD28/AD38 reconciliation explicitly permits extraordinary effectiveness without a compensating penalty. A revelation need not expose the entire exception to every observer; known claims, hidden truth and unbuilt capability remain distinct. An outlier may be repeatable or learnable through its actual means. Direct or lasting creation/conservation exceptions remain original adaptation where they depart from qualified canon, rather than silently rewriting the source. Safe numeric representation, real stock and current-state save integrity still apply.

IP and MT preserve useful selected invariants: opted-out durability behavior, instance identity following existing binding, costs/condition owned once, preview without spending, exact maker/commit snapshot and durable publication. A frozen draw/result does not automatically remove a real continuing tool/support requirement from pending work; the activity's actual contract decides whether later breakage interrupts, changes future stages or leaves already-settled work intact. The final example makes interrupted partial repair retain spent material and restored function while releasing only unspent reservations. Coin repair need not be kept valuable by inventing an arbitrary fee/risk for superior hand repair. Old-save compatibility deferral is scoped; present pending work, current reload/import and unrelated state remain protected. The one-line-main/domain design is an old proposed composition shape, not a universal core-edit allowance.

TQ199's later crack receipt is SOURCE READY with focused state/consumer checks and a named Iron-pickaxe/prying cause, while rebuilt native UI/persistence were explicitly unrun under that historical lock. It neither completes every typed damage/layered repair nor proves the lock is live now. TQ198/TQ236 sent-constraint records do not prove the recipient applied them. A local cross-reference is inconsistent: the earlier repair-outcome text points to TQ170 for identity, but identity-after-repair is TQ190 while TQ170 is the Village requirements row. Keep that correction for readers without renumbering the established tables. Proposed inspector truth remains developer-only and public reports keep sealed truth by ID.

Use current [making rules](MAKING_RULES.md), [architecture rules](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), [means/appraisal](MEANS_AND_APPRAISAL.md), [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md) and the actual item, durability, repair and craft owners. The tool-layer/exception ideas and original histories remain useful; no new condition store, damage type, repair command, migration, source pass, private-data publication, worker or runtime change is made here.
reviews.evidence: Actual complete739line read in five contiguous ranges through the final interruption reconciliation. Compared with current standing rules already read and earlier source/readiness distinctions; no current item/craft/runtime, linked IP/crack receipt, source chapter, private state or browser newly tested.
reviews.reopen: Use selected actual tool/repair owner, qualified world law and pending support/settlement terms; preserve later no-hard-gate correction and exact dated implementation floor rather than launching old IP phases.
